title: Uniform heart Ext bound necessary for Brown compactness
statement: Let X be a scheme and Λ a commutative condensed coefficient ring. Put S=Dctf(X,Λ) and L=Loc(S) [sk-def-localizing-closure]. If BrownHypothesesFor Λ X holds and K in L has underlying object in S, then there exists a natural N such that Hom(K,F[0][n])=0 for every module object F over Λ_X with F[0] in L and every n≥N. Consequently, if for every N there is such an F and an n≥N with a nonzero map K→F[0][n], the Brown bundle is false. This is a necessary bound conditional on Brown compactness, not a geometric vanishing assertion.

source.place: finite-support argument in not_preservesColimitsOfShape_of_forall_hom_ne_zero, generalized using DegreewiseLimits.lean, HomologicalComplex.isLimitFanMkProjOfIsColimit

proof.text: If there is no heart object with degree-zero image in L, take N=0 and the assertion is vacuous. Otherwise fix one such object F_0. For each n choose a heart object with a nonzero Hom group in degree n if one exists, and use F_0 otherwise. All chosen objects have degree-zero image in L. These choices are internal to a propositional proof.

Apply the varying-heart eventual-vanishing theorem to this sequence. For any n above its bound, the existence of any nonzero map into any eligible heart object would imply the chosen object has a nonzero map in degree n; eventual vanishing contradicts this. Thus the same bound works for every heart object.

For the contrapositive, instantiate the unboundedness hypothesis at the uniform bound, then apply the bound to its heart object, degree and nonzero morphism. The resulting zero equality is a contradiction.

theorem BrownHypothesesFor.exists_uniform_hom_single_shift_bound
    {Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}}
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] {X : Scheme.{u}} (hB : BrownHypothesesFor Λ X)
    (K : (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory)
    (hK : constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ X K.obj ∧
      DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ K.obj) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ F : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj Λ X),
      localizingClosureProEtale Λ X ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F) →
      ∀ n ≥ N, ∀ f : K.obj ⟶
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)⟦(n : ℤ)⟧, f = 0
